macros.name: onenimstick
macros.doc: There is a command \onenimstick that includes only the TikZ code for drawing a single Nim stick.

macros.name: setnimscale
macros.doc: The size can be further customised by a command \setnimscale{num}. This controls the height of the sticks, their thickness, the gaps between sticks, the gaps between heaps and the size of the wobble.

macros.name: setnimstickcolour
macros.doc: A command \setnimstickcolour{colour} is used to set the colour of the sticks, by default black.
